name: Eye of Elune grants 5% critical strike chance (#1211)
contract: Eye of Elune 704783 (Spell.dbc, family 32) tooltip: "Increases your critical strike chance by $s1%." Effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT (290), EffectBasePoints 4 with DieSides 1 (=5), TargetA 1, no class mask. Native path: AuraEffect::HandleAuraModCritPct calls Player::UpdateAllWeaponDependentCritAuras and UpdateAllSpellCritChances; Player::UpdateWeaponDependentCritAuras (Player.cpp) adds GetTotalAuraModifier(SPELL_AURA_MOD_CRIT_PCT) to the melee and ranged crit base-mod groups, Player::UpdateSpellCritChance (StatSystem.cpp) to every spell school, and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance reads those fields. Same race, class and level with no ratings, so the twin's crit values equal the talented fixture's baseline and the difference must be 5 points. The harness exposes melee and per-school spell crit, not the ranged field, which shares the same aura sum. Values read 2026-09-21 from the shipped /srv/coa/server-data/dbc/Spell.dbc. Result 20260921T080841274573008Z showed the melee before/after delta is not measurable: the control's PLAYER_CRIT_PERCENTAGE read 0 (field never recomputed on a fresh character) while the talented twin read 8.7048 = 5 flat + agility and weapon-skill terms that Player::UpdateCritPercentage (StatSystem.cpp) rewrites in the same pass. The melee clause therefore asserts effect 0's resolved aura amount (AuraEffect::GetAmount, 5) directly, as felsworn-fel-infusion does; the spell-school delta stays because Player::UpdateSpellCritChance is a pure sum whose baseline (3.4708 arcane) was populated.
